caption: The drawing features a bronze-colored statue of a standing male figure with a feathered headdress. The figure is turned in profile to the right, with his right arm extended forward and his left arm bent slightly backward. He is wearing a short tunic or skirt, a sash that crosses his chest from his left shoulder to his right hip, and a quiver with arrows on his back. The statue stands atop a horizontal green base that is balanced on a bronze sphere, which in turn is positioned atop a short vertical rod, all against a plain light beige background.
title: Metal Indian Weather Vane
